title: Generation of Immunodeficient Mice with Human Immune Systems via Hematopoietic Stem Cell Engraftment
author: Suheyla Hasgur
materials: Reserve 100,000 cells for flow cytometric analysis.

Depletion of CD3+ T cells Our laboratory uses reagents from Miltenyi Biotech to deplete human CD3+ T cells from UCB samples. The manufacture’s protocol was followed for depletion of human T cells ( See NOTE 2 )
Warm recipient mice using warming lamp.

steps.title: Warm reagents
steps.instruction: Allow Histopaque and RPMI supplemented with 0.5 % BSA to come to room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer umbilical cord blood
steps.instruction: Transfer umbilical cord blood (UCB) into 50 mL conical tubes, adding 30 mL of blood per tube.

steps.title: Add heparin to blood
steps.instruction: Add Hespan (heparin) to each tube of UCB to a final concentration of 20 % (v/v) and mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate for RBC sedimentation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes for 30 minutes at room temperature to allow red blood cells (RBC) to sediment.

steps.title: Remove excess RBC
steps.instruction: Using a 10 mL pipette, remove the bottom layer of RBC, leaving approximately 2 mL of the RBC volume in each tube.

steps.title: Adjust volume with RPMI
steps.instruction: Add RPMI supplemented with 0.5 % BSA to each tube to bring the total volume to 30 mL.

steps.title: Underlay histopaque
steps.instruction: Slowly underlay 14 mL of Histopaque onto each tube containing the UCB suspension, maintaining a clear interface between the Histopaque and the cell‑containing medium.

steps.title: Density gradient centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 30 minutes at 300 × g at room temperature with the centrifuge brake turned off.

steps.title: Remove plasma layer
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the top layer of plasma, leaving 2 mL of volume above the buffy coat layer.

steps.title: Collect buffy coat
steps.instruction: Remove the buffy coat layer and transfer it to a new 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Wash cells with RPMI
steps.instruction: Add 30 mL of RPMI supplemented with 0.5 % BSA to the tube containing the buffy coat and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 400 × g at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pool cell pellets
steps.instruction: Combine the resulting pellets from all tubes in a total volume of 10 mL RPMI supplemented with 0.5 % BSA.

steps.title: Optional DNase treatment
steps.instruction: If the pellet is viscous after resuspension, add 15 µL of DNase (10 000 U·mL⁻¹) per 30 mL of RPMI/BSA suspension.

steps.title: Viability count
steps.instruction: Perform a cell viability count on the pooled suspension.

steps.title: Second wash centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells for 5 minutes at 400 × g at 4 °C, then proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Resuspend CD3‑depleted cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the CD3‑depleted UCB cells in 1 mL RPMI supplemented with 0.5 % BSA and repeat a viability count.

steps.title: Validate CD3 depletion
steps.instruction: Stain an aliquot of the cells with anti‑human CD3 and anti‑human CD45 antibodies; CD3⁺/CD45⁺ cells must be <0.5 % of total. Use cells saved from step 1.15 as a positive control.

steps.title: Assess CD34+ HSC content
steps.instruction: Stain another aliquot with anti‑human CD34 and anti‑human CD45 antibodies; identify HSC as CD45^dim CD34⁺ cells.

steps.title: Keep cells on ice
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final cell preparation in RPMI + 0.5 % BSA and keep on ice until injection.

steps.title: Irradiate recipient mice
steps.instruction: Expose 21‑ to 28‑day‑old NSG mice (or newborn NSG pups) to whole‑body gamma irradiation at 100 cGy; perform HSC injection 4–24 hours post‑irradiation.

steps.title: Inject CD34+ cells
steps.instruction: Inject CD3‑depleted UCB cells to deliver 1 × 10⁵ CD34⁺ cells per mouse via the lateral tail vein. For newborn pups (24–72 h old), inject 5 × 10⁴ CD34⁺ cells intracardiacally.

steps.title: Verify hemostasis
steps.instruction: Ensure bleeding from the injection site has stopped, then return the mouse to its cage.
